ObjectSpawnerEntry.description: ObjectSpawnerEntry defines one object placement created by the mission object spawner.

customString.description: CustomString passes custom data to the spawned class's OnSpawnByObjectSpawner script callback.

enableCEPersistency.description:
EnableCEPersistency spawns the object without Central Economy persistence.
If a player takes it, persistence is enabled when the item supports it.

name.description:
Name is either a game config class name or a P3D model path.
P3D spawning is limited to DZ/plants, DZ/plants_bliss, DZ/plants_sakhal, DZ/rocks, DZ/rocks_bliss, and DZ/rocks_sakhal.

pos.description: Pos is the object's world position as an X/Y/Z vector in meters; Y is the vertical coordinate.

scale.description: Scale is the size multiplier applied to the spawned object or model.

ypr.description: YPR is the object's rotation in yaw, pitch, and roll order, in degrees. An empty vector leaves rotation unspecified.

ObjectSpawnerFile.description: ObjectSpawnerFile is a mission object list loaded through `cfggameplay.json -> WorldsData.objectSpawnersArr`.

Objects.description: Objects are the map objects to create with the configured class or model, transform, and persistence behavior.
